Particular attention is paid to the fuel mixture and ignition timing: their parameters depend on the compression ratio, boost pressure, and octane rating of the fuel. The game also simulates engine temperature and airflow. You can purchase a car from a used car dealer, where randomly generated variants with different characteristics are constantly appearing, and you can inspect them thoroughly before purchasing.

The open world allows you to freely roam the roads of Texas and test your assembled cars in a variety of conditions. For competitive enthusiasts, there are precision quarter- and eighth-mile races with groomed or ungroomed tracks, standard or professional starts, and leaderboards. Drifting, time trials, endurance races against computer-controlled opponents, and online multiplayer competitions are also available. The economic system strives to maintain realistic prices, so purchasing, maintaining, and upgrading a car requires prudent financial management.
